blocks.title: Realisations: mathematics $\to$ physics (the forced identifications, each with its falsifier)

rows.label: B1

rows.label: B2
rows.predicate: Mass is winding rate, $E=hf$; an acceleration advances phase at the rate $g/c$. Falsifier: a knee that does not track $H(z)$ (P1), or a rest mass with no winding.

rows.label: B3
rows.predicate: The acceleration floor is the phase-coherence threshold $g/c=\Hzero/2\pi$: the winding frequency reaches the drive's cyclic frequency (one radian of phase per Hubble time). Falsifier: a measured floor off $c\Hzero/2\pi$ beyond the $H_0$ uncertainty, or a floor that is directional or density-dependent (P6).

rows.label: B4
rows.predicate: Below the floor the registered force is read as an amplitude in the conjugate chart, the conserved flux as a count. Falsifier: a sub-floor law other than the geometric mean $\sqrt{\gb\az}$ at $x\ll1$, e.g.\ the wide-binary knee failing P3.

rows.label: B5
rows.predicate: The intrinsic scatter is the spread $\delta\alpha$ of the source's collective phase, read through the chart angle; its identification with the disk's dynamical temperature is the conjecture Y2. Falsifier: an intrinsic scatter that does not follow $\tan\alpha(x)$, i.e.\ no rise into the deep regime at fixed $\delta\alpha$ (P2).

rows.label: B6
rows.predicate: The lensing enhancement is the coherence-weighted amplitude, following the bulk-coherent components. Falsifier: a merger lensing peak tracking the shocked gas; the cluster-core residual off the amplitude-sum form over the core's composites is the exposure of the conjecture Y1.

rows.label: B7
rows.predicate: The cosmological constant is the curvature of the wrapped finite chart. Falsifier: $w\neq-1$, or a negative or scale-varying $\Lambda$ (C11).

rows.label: B8
rows.predicate: The masking barrier is the coincidence amplitude: registration fails when the killed noise walk first traverses the signal's amplitude $\sqrt x$ in the metric $\delta_A$ the floor rate induces, coefficient one. Falsifier: an approach to Newton departing from $1-e^{-\sqrt x}$ beyond the binned-RAR uncertainty (the simple rational form differs by up to $0.05$ in $\gobs/\gb$ at $\gb\approx5\az$), or a knee displaced from $c\Hzero/2\pi$ ($\kappa^{2}\neq1$). Present confrontation: the binned SPARC relation departs from $1-e^{-\sqrt x}$ by less than the bin scatter in every bin of $2<x<10$, the rational form disfavoured in $\chi^2$ (\src{dark.rar\_shape}).

legend.name: Import
legend.text: A standard result or measured datum used here without reproof.

legend.name: Realisation
legend.text: A forced identification of a physical term with the substrate object it denotes: constitutive, not interpretive; defended by its registered consequences; killed by the falsifier stated in its row.

legend.name: Definition
legend.text: A naming or set-up move, carrying no empirical content.

legend.name: Theorem
legend.text: Derived within this paper from the rows above it; where a family identifier is named, its content is verified by the validation package.

legend.name: Theorem on a realisation
legend.text: A theorem consumed through a declared realisation: in block P the paper's predictions, each derived and witnessed, stated with its falsifier and its present confrontation; a refuted confrontation fires the realisation's falsifier, not the theorem.

legend.name: $\Om$-hard
legend.text: Decided by the totality; not closeable by a bounded observer.

legend.name: Open (conjecture)
